blocks.x: Yield +2.8 points, recalls scoped in minutes — quality and traceability program
Identity withheld — A food processor (dairy), Agriculture & Food Systems sector, outcome-linked engagement, blended delivery team. Figures are the client's own, shared with permission.
Process yield opaque; losses accepted. Traceability document-based; recall scoping days.

Vision grading at intake standardized quality decisions; the yield analytics platform decomposed losses by line and lot; cold-chain telemetry made safety evidence continuous; and the lot-traceability network (Ledger) answers recall queries in minutes with anchored custody events.
Outcomes, as the client reported them
What the success is actually made of

items: the models and retrieval systems were evaluated before anyone trusted them — grounded answers, cited sources, measured quality.
the data spine was certified once and reused everywhere, which is why the numbers held up under audit.
the physical layer stayed synchronized with reality, so the decisions made on top of it were trustworthy.

blocks.x: If the food processor (dairy) program reads like your own estate, the honest advice is: start with the baseline diagnostic, not with the build. The differences that matter only show up in measurement The engagement model here was build-transfer; the same pattern runs fixed-scope where the estate allows it.
Figures on this page are the client's, reproduced with permission. Method notes and measurement designs are available under NDA.
Start with the diagnostic, not the contract: the same diagnostic baselined in two weeks, and a scoped proposal only if the delta justifies it.
